subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Adroit
solution:
The correct answer is "**Skilful**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• **"Adroit" means having or showing skill, cleverness, or resourcefulness.**(निपुण)

 
 
• Example: She was adroit at playing the piano.
 
 
 
• Synonyms of Adroit are Skilful, Dexterous, Deft, and Proficient.
 
• **​"Skilful" means (used about a person) very good at doing something.** (व्‍यक्ति) कोई काम करने में निपुण; कुशल)
 
 
• Example: She is very skilful when it comes to creative things.
 
 
 
 
 
• Thus, it is clear that the word "skilful" is the synonym of the word "adroit."

Hence,** the correct answer is option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Clumsy means awkward in movement or ungraceful.(अनाड़ी)
 
• Despotic means exercising absolute power or control.(निरंकुश)
 
• Sane means mentally sound or rational.(समझदार)
